what: Records of the model zoo's d1-3B fixture whose text the zoo publishes (11 SemIf items, the model card's three example requests, the two long states written for the port; two drawn pictures, their files not included) with the Python reference's run of the shipped Mac decoder (d1_3b_decode_fp16_pf64_s, its AOT asset on the Mac GPU, the tower d1_3b_vision_fp16w32_s): per question the provider's row ids (sha256 of json.dumps(ids); the zoo's little-endian int32 digest beside it), the rendered text's sha256, the readout groups, the decoder's hidden rows (sha256 of the fp16 [T, 2048] bytes), z = h . E[id] in float64 for every read id, p (float64 bits) and the provider's fp32 oracle p; per record the provider's input_tokens and response text. D13BTests reads them through KitD1Decider.

sources.zoo_swift_host: apps/D1 gave every one of these rows bit for bit on the same assets (gate-d1-3b-swift.json)
